Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded

Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave
Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.
